strings.zh: 奇怪？听不大清楚,{NEWLINE}电话坏了么？{SCROLL}你换个地方再打试试！
strings.en: Wha... I can’t make out what you’re{NEWLINE}saying! This connection is no good!{SCROLL}Call from somewhere better, OK?

strings.zh: 喂喂⋯⋯{NEWLINE}啊,你不用担心我,{CLEAR}我身体好着呢。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hello...{NEWLINE}Ah, you don’t need to worry{CLEAR}about me. I’m in great shape.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 口袋妖怪的修行之旅{NEWLINE}就是要不前往新的地方、{CLEAR}不断与沿途的训练家们战斗,{CLEAR}然后不断让自己变强！
strings.en: A Pokémon training journey means{NEWLINE}heading to new places, battling{CLEAR}every Trainer along the way, and{CLEAR}getting stronger and stronger!

strings.zh: 我星期天不到晚上{NEWLINE}就忙得停不下来。{SCROLL}到了晚上可以再打电话给我！
strings.en: On Sundays I’m swamped until evening.{SCROLL}Call me again at night!

strings.zh: 我现在正好很无聊！{NEWLINE}想和我再来对战一场吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: I was just looking for something{NEWLINE}to do!{CLEAR}Wanna battle me again? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 太好了,{NEWLINE}这次我不会输了！{SCROLL}我在战斗前线的训练家屋等你！
strings.en: Great! This time I won’t lose!{SCROLL}I’ll be waiting for you at the Trainer{NEWLINE}House at the Battle Frontier!
strings.notes: US 0647/6 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.en: Oh yeah? Sounds like you’re{NEWLINE}pretty busy yourself.

strings.zh: 什么？{NEWLINE}你还有很多{CLEAR}和其他人的预约吗？
strings.en: Wha...? You’ve still got a bunch of{NEWLINE}plans with other people?
strings.notes: US 0647/8 | RV070: addition: zh: plain question; US added complaint

strings.zh: 我在战斗前线的训练家屋等你。{CLEAR}说定了！
strings.en: I’ll be waiting at the Trainer House{NEWLINE}at the Battle Frontier. It’s a deal!
strings.notes: US 0647/9 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 我们不是约好了在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋对战的吗？{CLEAR}难道你忘了？{CLEAR}我等着你！
strings.en: Didn’t we agree to battle at the{NEWLINE}Trainer House at the Battle Frontier?{CLEAR}Don’t tell me you forgot! I’m waiting!
strings.notes: US 0647/11 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 我只要一看到精灵{NEWLINE}就会有一种奇怪的感觉。{SCROLL}它们有圆的,方的；{NEWLINE}会飞的,会游唦的；{CLEAR}会燃烧的,会冰冻的；{CLEAR}有发光的,有黑暗的。{CLEAR}精灵有着各种各样的类型,{SCROLL}有时候我会想{SCROLL}人类会不会也是{NEWLINE}一种精灵呢⋯⋯
strings.en: Whenever I look at Pokémon,{NEWLINE}I get this weird feeling.{SCROLL}There are round ones and square{NEWLINE}ones, flying ones and swimming{CLEAR}ones, burning ones and freezing{CLEAR}ones, shining ones and dark ones.{CLEAR}Pokémon come in all kinds of types.{SCROLL}Sometimes I wonder...{SCROLL}Maybe people are just{NEWLINE}another kind of Pokémon...

strings.zh: 培育精灵是一件非常有趣的是,{NEWLINE}思考着如何让自己的队伍{CLEAR}构成合理、打击面更广、抗性更强。{SCROLL}然后去收集、培养{NEWLINE}构建队伍所需要的精灵,{CLEAR}这就是我成为训练家的乐趣啊。
strings.en: Raising Pokémon is a blast. You{NEWLINE}figure out how to build a team{CLEAR}that’s well balanced, hits a wide{CLEAR}range of types and can take a hit.{SCROLL}Then you go out and catch and train{NEWLINE}the Pokémon the team needs. That’s{CLEAR}what makes being a Trainer fun for me.

strings.zh: 我在旅行的途中,{NEWLINE}遇到过不少优秀的训练家。{CLEAR}你如果不加把劲继续锻炼的话,{CLEAR}迟早会被他们超越的。
strings.en: On my travels, I’ve met plenty of great{NEWLINE}Trainers. If you don’t keep training{CLEAR}hard, they’ll pass you sooner or later.
